statusDetail: Coverage complete: 58/58 checks judged. 34 findings (14 high, 14 medium, 6 low).

page.framework: Server-rendered MPA with legacy JavaScript/jQuery-style bundles
page.notes: Public Italian adult-video catalogue with mandatory age confirmation, cookie consent, listing/search/category templates, a player detail page and account flows. Coverage excludes authenticated-only settings, upload, payment completion, live-cam and third-party outbound destinations because they require credentials, money, or leave the audited origin.

paths.description: Homepage and age/cookie entry journey; represents the primary discovery feed.
Amatoriale category listing; represents filtered/listing templates and pagination.
Representative video detail/player page; represents the core watch journey.
Search results for “italiano”; represents query and results-state behaviour.
Account/sign-up surface; represents forms, validation, authentication and commercial promotion.
Deliberate unknown URL; represents HTTP/navigation recovery.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark-colour preference.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark, the probe still reported colorScheme “normal” and a white rgb(255,255,255) body; the dark screenshot is visually unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven surface/text tokens, using light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme query.

findings.summary: Navigation and state changes use abrupt full-document swaps.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across home, category and detail found no view-transition declarations; the entry recording shows direct overlay swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation and a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The long feed has no scroll-state-aware navigation or progress affordance.
findings.evidence: The homepage has a long/infinite feed, but DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, progress marker, or shrinking-header behaviour.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sticky header that responds to scroll state, or a lightweight progress/return affordance on long listings.

findings.summary: Dropdown/menu positioning is custom rather than anchored to its trigger.
findings.evidence: The navigation exposes menus, but CSS inspection found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning with fallback positions for menus and tooltips near viewport edges.

findings.summary: Two consecutive full-viewport gates interrupt entry before content can be used.
findings.evidence: The first-load screenshot shows the age gate; after accepting it, the recording reveals a second cookie wall that obscures the whole page.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the necessary age check concise, then use a non-blocking consent surface with equally visible choices.

findings.summary: Blocking overlays are generic divs without dialog semantics.
findings.evidence: Across five DOM captures, the gates expose no <dialog>, role=dialog, or popover; the recon found zero semantic dialogs.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the blocking age flow with <dialog>, an accessible name, initial focus, focus containment and deterministic close behaviour.

findings.summary: Reusable cards rely on viewport layouts rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no @container rules even though video cards are reused in desktop grids and narrow layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card regions containment and adapt them with size container queries where composition changes.

findings.summary: Several controls lose visible keyboard focus and text links have very small hit areas.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe found header buttons and search controls at outline:none with no box-shadow; multiple links were only 15–16px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible ring and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 24px, preferably 44px for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: Homepage loading is slow enough to miss the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 4.1s and LCP 5.4s; the independent trace measured LCP 4.41s. CLS remained near zero.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce render-blocking work, and defer below-fold images and non-critical scripts.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache policy delay first content.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 124 requests/2.89MB, parser-inserted high-priority CSS/JS, and many images without useful cache headers; Lighthouse estimated 3.0s render-blocking savings and 1.44MB cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, set long immutable CDN caching, and preload only the true LCP asset.

findings.summary: Large amounts of unused CSS and JavaScript ship on the homepage.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 580KiB unused JavaScript and 206KiB unused CSS; HAR shows a 517KB default.js plus HLS code on the listing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by template/capability and load HLS/player code only when a player is requested.

findings.summary: Many images and controls have no accessible name or text alternative.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 98 of 100 images without alt; Lighthouse found 100 missing image alternatives, two unnamed buttons and one unnamed link.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide meaningful thumbnail alternatives or empty alt for redundant imagery, and label every icon-only control.

findings.summary: Some text fails minimum colour contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s colour-contrast audit reported a failing node on both the homepage and account surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state and verify under contrast preferences.

findings.summary: The main templates lack heading structure and several buttons suppress focus indication.
findings.evidence: All five representative DOM captures contain zero h1 elements; the focus probe found focused header/search buttons with outline:none and no replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 per template, preserve logical heading order, and implement a visible :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: The viewport restricts zoom and video alternatives are not evident.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because user scaling is restricted; inspection of the representative player found no caption tracks in the tested state.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable restrictions and maximum-scale limits; provide captions/transcripts for published video where required.

findings.summary: The account page emits a console error during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported one errors-in-console item on /account/create while the homepage had none.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the account-page exception and add representative-route console monitoring in CI.

findings.summary: Nearly all thumbnail images omit intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 99 of 100 images without width/height; Lighthouse reported 101 unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height or aspect-ratio from known thumbnail metadata to reserve layout space.

findings.summary: Deprecated browser API usage remains in production code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported one deprecated-API warning on both audited templates and legacy JavaScript with an estimated 51KiB saving.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the deprecated call and stop serving legacy transforms to modern browsers.

findings.summary: Metadata is generic or mismatched on some important templates.
findings.evidence: The account/create page is titled “Account login” despite also being registration, and Lighthouse SEO was 0.58 there.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each template a unique purpose-specific title and description, including distinct sign-in and registration metadata.

findings.summary: A small set of navigation links is not crawlable or descriptively named.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported one non-crawlable anchor and one non-descriptive link on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations and descriptive accessible link text for every navigation action.

findings.summary: Representative public pages omit canonical URLs.
findings.evidence: All five DOM captures lacked rel=canonical, although robots.txt permits public content, hreflang exists and sitemap.xml is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonical links on indexable templates and keep them aligned with hreflang and sitemap URLs.

findings.summary: The video detail page lacks structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: Recon and detail DOM inspection found no JSON-LD, including no VideoObject, despite the page representing a rich video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and matching Open Graph preview metadata on detail pages.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but important response defenses are absent or weakened.
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no HSTS or nosniff and a CSP containing unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; the session cookie is Secure/HttpOnly but SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable HSTS and nosniff, remove CSP unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline through nonces or hashes, and use the narrowest viable SameSite policy.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only with no phishing-resistant option.
findings.evidence: The account DOM exposes email/password forms but no WebAuthn/passkey signal; no permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside a correctly annotated password fallback.

findings.summary: The browser-policy baseline is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no HSTS, Permissions-Policy or nosniff, a permissive no-referrer-when-downgrade policy, and no Trusted Types requirement; X-Frame-Options is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a minimal Permissions-Policy, strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy, frame-ancestors, and Trusted Types where the legacy script surface permits.

findings.summary: The Italian video detail page declares the wrong document language.
findings.evidence: The homepage/category/search/account declare lang=it, but the representative Italian detail page declares lang=en-GB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang from the active locale on every template and retain hreflang for alternates.

findings.summary: Cookie choice is visually asymmetric.
findings.evidence: After the mandatory age step, “Accetta tutti i cookie” is a large red button while “Rifiuta tutti i cookie” is a small underlined text control below it.
findings.suggestedFix: Present accept and reject with equal visual weight and keep preference management available without nagging.

findings.summary: Validation errors are visible but not programmatically announced or attached to invalid fields.
findings.evidence: Empty submission produced a localized error summary, but the probe found no role=alert and no aria-invalid on invalid controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Focus an accessible error summary, use aria-describedby/aria-invalid, and validate after interaction.

findings.summary: Sign-in and sign-up fields omit standard autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: Email/current-password and sign-up email/password fields returned empty autocomplete values; only new-password fields were annotated.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username/email, current-password and new-password tokens consistently.

findings.summary: The account surface promotes premium membership without pricing or commitment details in the decision context.
findings.evidence: The account screenshot gives half the viewport to “Registrazione Premium” benefits and a join CTA, but no price, renewal or cancellation terms are visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Show price, billing cadence, renewal and cancellation terms next to the premium CTA; keep free registration visually distinct.

findings.summary: Thumbnail delivery is not resource-efficient.
findings.evidence: Images audit found 99 legacy-format images, 100 without srcset, 90 below-fold images without lazy loading and three oversized assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP sources, add srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Repeated feed traversal retains a rapidly growing DOM and heap.
findings.evidence: After ten bottom/top feed traversals, DOM nodes grew from 2,870 to 19,432 and measured JS heap from 10.1MB to 13.8MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualise or prune distant feed items and avoid retaining observers/listeners for content no longer near the viewport.

findings.summary: The listing page pays a large image and player-code budget before the user chooses media.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 2.89MB and 124 requests, including 106 images, 760KB script and HLS code on the feed; 116 requests came from CDN subdomains.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer player libraries until intent, lazy-load feed imagery, and enforce per-template byte/request budgets.

findings.summary: The long feed grows substantially under repeated traversal without releasing prior content.
findings.evidence: Baseline-to-post heap summaries grew from 386,850 to 495,584 nodes and 27.9MB to 36.2MB self size; in-page DOM count rose 2,870→19,432. This indicates unbounded feed retention, though no Detached* constructor was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the feed window and release nodes, observers and handlers for distant items; repeat the same test until retained growth plateaus.

taskList.title: Restore semantic, accessible entry and keyboard behaviour
Harden response headers and browser-enforced security policies
Cut render-blocking, unused and prematurely loaded code
Build a responsive, lazy, modern thumbnail pipeline
Add complete accessible names, heading structure and contrast tokens
Make consent choices visually equal and reduce sequential interruption
Bound the infinite feed DOM and verify memory plateaus
Fix authentication assistance, validation announcements and passkey support
Complete canonical, structured and template-specific metadata
